enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn onto right side. Stretch legs. Yawn. Roll onto back. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush away. Remove pajamas. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place bread in toaster. Turn on toaster. Take out plate. Put eggs on plate. Put toast on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: getting ready for work and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on desk lamp. Pick up phone. Open closet. Take out work clothes. Put on work clothes. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put phone in bag. Put charger in bag. Put notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up keys. Pick up wallet. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off fan. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Write reports. Use computer. Talk to colleagues. Print documents. File papers. Organize desk. Check schedule. Update calendar.
Leave office. Walk to restaurant. Pick up menu. Read menu. Order food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Wait for food. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Walk back to office. Enter building.

Sit at desk. Open computer. Review documents. Make phone calls. Attend meeting. Take notes. Write emails. Update database. Talk to colleagues. Print documents. File papers. Organize desk. Check schedule. Update calendar. Leave office.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off induction cooker. Take out plate. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up.

Clear table. Scrape plates. Load dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wash pans by hand. Turn on tap. Apply soap. Scrub pans. Rinse pans. Turn off tap. Dry pans. Put away pans. Wipe counters. Sweep floor. Turn off light.

Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Change channels. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Use remote. Change channels. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
